changelog: - **The phone's run bar says why Play paused.** When Play paused itself at a core stop of a bundled example, or the run went past the steps the example is checked over, the desktop run row said so but the phone's run bar did not, so a phone user saw Play stop with no reason. The bar now shows the same line as a row under its controls, and a screen reader hears it once, as on the desktop.
